name: pitwall
description: Live terminal dashboard of your Claude Code agents, models, effort and token use

scripts.build:
tsc --noEmit && rm -rf dist && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --alias:react-devtools-core=./build/empty.js --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
